Sneha Nair
Senior DevOps Engineer | Pimpri-Chinchwad
sneha.nair810@example.com | +91 9765382049

Experienced DevOps engineer focused on building reliable CI/CD pipelines and scalable infrastructure. Strong track record implementing container orchestration and infrastructure-as-code to reduce deployment time and improve system stability. Collaborative team player with a practical approach to automation and incident response.

Experience
Kite Learning, Jan 2025 - Present
Senior DevOps Engineer (Remote)
- Designed and deployed a multi-tenant Kubernetes platform that hosted 24 microservices, improving deployment frequency by 4x and reducing staging-to-production lead time from 2 days to under 2 hours using k8s and Docker.
- Implemented Git-based CI pipelines integrating automated image builds and security scans, cutting build failures due to environment drift by 60%.
- Automated cluster provisioning and horizontal autoscaling for course delivery workloads, lowering cloud spend by 22% during off-peak hours using k8s.
- Documented runbooks and created Confluence pages for on-call rotations and incident playbooks, decreasing mean time to recovery (MTTR) by 35%.

Tata Consultancy Services, Mar 2016 - Dec 2024
DevOps Engineer (Onsite/Client-facing)
- Consolidated container strategy across three enterprise projects by migrating legacy VMs to Docker images and standardizing runtime, reducing environment inconsistencies by 75%.
- Developed and maintained Terraform modules to provision VPCs, managed services, and CI/CD runners; standardized templates reduced provisioning time from days to 1 hour.
- Built Jenkins pipelines for automated testing and deployment across multiple clients, enabling blue/green deployments and cutting rollback incidents by 50%.
- Led weekly Agile ceremonies with cross-functional teams and authored Confluence guides for branching and release practices; improved sprint predictability and deployment coordination.

Vertex Analytics, Feb 2013 - Feb 2016
DevOps Engineer (Onsite)
- Created automated infrastructure templates using Terraform to provision analytics clusters and supporting networks, reducing manual setup errors and provisioning time by 80%.
- Implemented Jenkins-driven CI workflows for ETL job packaging and deployment, reducing release cycle time from weekly to bi-weekly with fewer hotfixes.
- Containerized analytics tooling using Docker for reproducible dev environments and standardized images across teams, improving developer onboarding speed.
- Maintained Git repositories, enforced branching strategy and pull request reviews, and contributed to internal Confluence documentation for platform operations.

Projects
- Internal CI/CD Dashboard: Built a dashboard that aggregated Jenkins job status, Docker image vulnerabilities, and k8s pod health; helped SREs prioritize fixes and reduced unnoticed failures by 40%.
- Infrastructure Cost Analyzer: Scripted periodic reports combining Terraform state and cloud billing data to highlight unused resources; recommendations reclaimed ~18% of idle spend.

Skills
Languages: Git
Stack: k8s, Terraform, Docker, Jenkins
Collaboration: Confluence, Agile

Education
B.Com, Narsee Monjee College
